what: AR43, Seam's lit glass (research's B, 15:04; the four screens passed at 15:49): the kit every screen Home opens wears, beside Config.UIKit's Seam. Equipment's rows and Reinforce's ring are in ../equipment/equipment.json. From tools/blender/seam_cut.py; drawn in code, no image input

SeamGlassLit.note: SeamLit with its Panel and Button white falling to this lavender; the rest SeamLit's

palette.note: beside Seam and SeamLit in Config.UIKit's Palettes, for every screen Home opens (Equipment's three, Settings; AR42's picker later, by the register's scope). Seam's own values where B kept them (Pressed, Ground, Core); Backing is a gradient here, top to foot; Well's foot is WellFoot, as Config.Hud.Seam.WellFoot is Seam's. The Voidkin screen and the bag stay on Seam until the director's word

ground.backing: a Frame over the whole screen, under the band: UIGradient Rotation 90, Color Backing top to foot

bloom.note: its middle, in points on the smallest phone: on Equipment the work panel's middle across, 90 under the page's top; on Settings the card's middle

topLight.note: a Frame across the screen's top under the band, the glint, a UIGradient down it (Rotation 90) with these Transparency stops: 1 - 0.06 exp(-y / 40)

stack: PanelFill (the kit's): a UIGradient down it (Rotation 90), Color Panel top to foot; ImageTransparency 0, the panel solid
PanelSheen: across the panel's top at its own height, the glint at 0.89
PanelEdge (the kit's): the facet, a UIGradient down it (Rotation 90), Transparency 0.1 at 0, 0.7 at 0.85 and at 1: lit from above
PanelCornerGlint: its top left on the panel's, the glint at 0.15
panel.corners: the kit's PanelFill and PanelEdge corners (10 and 3), as the game has them; the sheets drew 8 and 0, and seam_cut.png's fit is drawn on the kit's

line.note: Frames centred on x, in pieces (top, foot) by the open screen: between the buttons, never through a button or a word

chosen: the mark (1.05 r high, the glint)
rest: the mark (1.05 r high, the soft)
rail.touch: the button's disc and its word, at least 44 points each way; a tap on the open one does nothing
rail.back: Back stays top left and returns to Home; the title reads Equipment (the director, 14:59)

stack: the words in the Ink, 14 bold, centred
press.sheen: once a loop, a white band across the press, 0.75 at its middle, 6 points round (exp(-(d / 6)^2)), leaning 0.5 points left for each point down, its middle at the top running from 30 left of the press to 30 right of it with the idle's phase: the kit's Shine (UI/Kit/Shine) on a white copy of PressFill keeps it inside the press's cut corners
press.note: the lit press only (Put in, Replace, Take out, Reinforce); quiet and off presses stay Seam's

settings.held: while dragged: the knob 12.5 (from 10) over 0.08 s (out3), its ring shown, the fill's light at 0.55 and its glow at 0.70, the knob's glow at 0.35, the name and value in the light; back the same way on release. Each change is heard or seen at once
settings.touch: the whole row drags its slider; the knob's touch at least 44 points

idle.phase: (time mod loop) / loop, one phase for every piece on the screen
pieces: ReinforceComet and RailComet: Rotation 360 x phase
idle.reducedMotion: with the player's reduced motion on, nothing idles (as the kit's Shine)

open: the screen fades in over open_time (out3), rising open_rise points to its place, over the game
row k fades in sliding from row_from points left, from row_start + k x row_gap over row_time (out3)
the work fades in from work_start over work_time (out3)
Reinforce's ring draws round once, clockwise from the top, from ring_start over ring_time (smooth)
the gear grows from pop_from to 1 from pop_start over pop_time (backOut, s = pop_back), fading in over its first third
the band and the rail are there from the start
switch: a rail tap: the tapped button grows 20 to 27 as the last shrinks 27 to 20, over switch_time (backOut, s = switch_back); their looks, chosen or at rest, change at the tap
the rail's words and the rows crossfade over cross_time (smooth)
the work dips: the old fades out over the first half of cross_time, the new in over the second (smooth), never both at once; the panel stays

PanelSheen.use: the panel's lift: across its top at its own height (96), sliced at its ends, over PanelFill

PanelCornerGlint.use: the light along the panel's top-left corner, over PanelEdge: its top left on the panel's; on a panel under 200 by 160 points, clipped to it

ScreenBloom.use: the bloom behind the work: laid at 750 by 600 points (its two radii 150 and 120, drawn to 2.5 of each), its middle on the bloom's (seam.json, ground); a smooth falloff, so 256 pixels serve it stretched

RailDisc.tint: a UIGradient down it (Rotation 90): Color the Card top to foot when chosen, the Button's at rest, held at 1/56 and 55/56 (the disc's top and foot)
RailDisc.use: a rail button's glass: its middle on the button's, laid at 2 (r + 1) points for its radius r

RailSheen.tint: the glint #F0EAFF at ImageTransparency 0.78 chosen, 0.88 at rest
RailSheen.use: the light on a rail button's top: laid as RailDisc

RailLight.use: the chosen button's glass lit toward its right: laid as RailDisc; chosen only

RailGlow.use: the chosen button's glow, under its disc: laid at 2 (r + 24) points; chosen only

RailEdge.use: a button's hairline, 1 point wide inside its disc, drawn at 20: laid at 2 (r + 1) points

RailEdgeChosen.use: a button's hairline, 1 point wide inside its disc, drawn at 27: laid at 2 (r + 1) points

RailRing.use: a button's outer ring, 1 wide just inside 23.5 points round, broken top left and foot right, lit from above: laid at 2 (r + 4.5) points

RailRingChosen.use: a button's outer ring, 1.6 wide just inside 30.5 points round, broken top left and foot right, lit from above: laid at 2 (r + 4.5) points

RailComet.use: the idle's comet on the chosen button's ring, its head at the top: laid as RailRingChosen, Rotation 360 x the idle's phase (clockwise); it runs on over the ring's two gaps, which a turning image can't keep

RailRunner.use: the idle's light down the rail's line: its middle at x 48 and y = the rail's top + (its foot - its top) x the idle's phase; clipped to each piece of the line

PressFill.tint: a UIGradient down it (Rotation 90), Color as seam.json's press.fill: white falling to lavender, its foot more so
PressFill.use: the lit press's body: its box the press's, sliced

PressEdge.use: the lit press's hairline: as PressFill

PressGlow.use: the lit press's glow, under it: its box the press's with Pad on every side, sliced

SliderTrack.use: the slider's channel, in its own colours: from the slider's start to its end, 8 high on its middle, sliced at its ends

SliderFill.tint: a UIGradient across it (Rotation 0): Color the facet to the light
SliderFill.use: the light filling the channel: from 1 past its start to the knob's middle, 6 high; hidden under 6 points long

SliderFillLight.use: the fill's lit top: laid as SliderFill

SliderFillGlow.use: the fill's glow, over the fill: SliderFill's box with Pad on every side, sliced at its ends

SliderKnob.tint: a UIGradient down it (Rotation 90): Color #FFFFFF to #D4C6FF, held at 1/27 and 26/27 (the disc's top and foot)
SliderKnob.use: the knob, drawn at its held radius 12.5: its middle on the fill's end, laid at 2 (r + 1) points, r 10 at rest

SliderKnobSheen.use: the knob's lit top: laid as SliderKnob

SliderKnobEdge.use: the knob's hairline, drawn at rest (10): laid at 2 (r + 1) points, so held it is 1.25 wide

SliderKnobGlow.use: the knob's glow, under it, drawn at rest: laid at 2 (r + 18) x r / 10 points

SliderKnobRing.use: held only: the ring round the knob, 1.4 wide just inside 17 points round, laid at 36 points on the knob's middle
